description: This Java class `FeatureDefinitionDeletedStrategy` handles the `FeatureDefinitionDeleted` event by removing a feature definition from a `ThingBuilder`. It extends an abstract event strategy tailored for such events, implementing the application logic for event processing within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionDeletedStrategy
classes.description: Final class implementing a specific event handling strategy for `FeatureDefinitionDeleted` events, removing feature definitions from things.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies the event by removing the feature definition with the given feature ID from the ThingBuilder.
